suite_quality.steady_state_hypothesis: PR closeout evidence separates local validation from CI, review, tracker, and merge-readiness claims.
suite_quality.decision_metric: reviewer can classify the closeout claim without relying on prose-only confidence
guardrail_metrics: CI status remains non-proof unless explicit CI evidence is present
merge readiness remains non-proof unless explicit merge evidence is present
suite_quality.denominator: all PR closeout packets evaluated by this suite
suite_quality.residual_uncertainty: artifact-only inspection cannot prove target product behavior
